allow: PowerShell(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, StartTime, CPU, WS | Format-Table -AutoSize; if \(Test-Path dist\) { "dist last write: " + \(Get-Item dist\).LastWriteTime; "dist files: " + \(Get-ChildItem dist -Recurse -File | Measure-Object\).Count } else { "no dist" })

Bash(node -e "console.log\('CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:', process.env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN ? 'set' : 'NOT set'\); console.log\('CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:', process.env.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID ? 'set' : 'NOT set'\)")

PowerShell($p = Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'xdg.config\\.wrangler\\config\\default.toml'; $line = Select-String -Path $p -Pattern '^expiration_time' | Select-Object -First 1; $line.Line; if \($line.Line -match '"\([^"]+\)"'\) { $exp = [datetime]::Parse\($matches[1]\); "expira: $exp"; "ahora  : " + \(Get-Date\); if \($exp -lt \(Get-Date\)\) { "=> CADUCADO hace " + [math]::Round\(\(\(Get-Date\) - $exp\).TotalDays,1\) + " dias" } else { "=> vigente" } })
